messages.body_plain:
-------- Forwarded Message --------
From: Google Summer of Code <summerofco...@google.com>
To: bgpbra...@gmail.com
Subject: GSoC 2021: Important Notes for final weeks of program
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2021 22:30:05 -0700

Thank you for being a vital part of the GSoC 2021 program. We realize this has been another challenging year for everyone, thank you all for your commitment to your students and your communities.

In about a week and a half, students will begin submitting their Final Evaluations and work products for GSoC 2021 (starting Monday, August 16). We have encouraged students to reach out to you to share a preview of their submission URL and let you verify it meets Google's <https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/help/work-product> and your requirements before they submit later this month. Students can not edit their evaluations once they have submitted them — it's in their best interest to have you review the link first. FYI, students must submit their Final Evaluations (with the submission URL) on their Google dashboard before Monday, August 23 at 18:00 UTC.

Mentor Final Evaluations (of students) Start Monday, August 23rd at 18:01 UTC
Mentors are responsible for validating the target of the URL (provided in the evaluation), making sure it points to the GSoC 2021 work product, and meets the other requirements <https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/help/work-product>. Mentors will use this information as part of their pass/fail decision. The deadline for Mentors to submit Final Evaluations is Monday, August 30 at 18:00 UTC.

You can preview the final evaluation questions here <https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/help/evaluations>.
Tips for communicating with your Student these last couple of weeks

It is very important to keep communicating with your students and encourage them to remain involved with your community. The orgs that have been most successful in keeping their GSoC students as long term contributors to their project have encouraged their students to become maintainers on their projects and make it clear they have ownership of a particular area of the project. Encourage the students to stay invested in the work they have done over the GSoC period.

Be sure to read the Mentor Guide <https://google.github.io/gsocguides/mentor/> section on Building a Lifetime Contributor <https://google.github.io/gsocguides/mentor/building-a-lifetime-contributor> for more tips.
Upcoming Important Dates

August 16-23: Students wrap up their projects and submit final evaluation of their mentor which includes:
1) link to their work product (code) and
2) their Final Evaluation of their Mentor
August 23 18:00 UTC: Deadline for Students to submit their Final Evaluation
August 23-30: Mentors submit final evaluations of students
August 30 18:00 UTC: Deadline for submission of Mentor's Final Evaluation of their Student
August 31: Students passing GSoC 2021 are announced
Late October/early Nov: Mentor Summit (date TBD)
Important Links

Reminder to read these 1-pagers from the GSoC Mentor Guide <https://google.github.io/gsocguides/mentor/>: Building a Lifetime Contributor <https://google.github.io/gsocguides/mentor/building-a-lifetime-contributor>, Upstream Integration <https://google.github.io/gsocguides/mentor/upstream-integration>
Roles and Responsibilities <https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/help/responsibilities>
GSoC 2021 Mentor and Org Admin Email Archive <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pxrT8hPPhh0rCSuanVQinGHQKp4Pev0oXkDU2a7UU68/edit?usp=sharing>

Please email Google Administrators at gsoc-s...@google.com if you have any questions.

Best, Stephanie

This email was sent to bgpbra...@gmail.com.

You are receiving this email because of your participation in Google Summer of Code 2021.
https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com

To leave the program and stop receiving all emails, you can go to your profile <https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/dashboard/profile/> and request deletion of your program profile.

For any questions, please contact gsoc-s...@google.com. Replies to this message go to an unmonitored mailbox.

© 2021 Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA

messages.subject: student evaluations are due soon!
messages.body_plain:
Students,

Student evaluations are due this weekend.  If you fail to submit your project repository and fill out the evaluation, you will fail the final evaluation.  Google's deadlines are firm, and they *do not* make exceptions.

I just checked, and 71% of R GSoC student final evaluations are not complete.  You need to complete these ASAP.

Mentors, please communicate with your students and make sure they submit the code repository location and fill out the final evaluations.  Mentor final evaluations start on Monday!

Regards,

Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/
Ph: 773-459-4973
IM: bgpbraverock
